posts.text: Yes, quite aggressive but there is a possibility (slim). If that ₹241/kg realization holds for the rest of FY27 (not just Q1), that alone pushes MCC revenue above a flat-volume ₹400 Cr estimate, independent of any utilization improvement, pure price, not volume.
